metadata.description: Origination Workbench operations workbook (Azure Monitor Workbook). One shared workbook that spans Dev, QA and Production through an Environment picker. The workbook body lives in origination-workbench.workbook.json and is passed in as the serializedData parameter by the deploy workflow.
Name shown in Azure Monitor > Workbooks.
The workbook content (Notebook/1.0 JSON) as a single string. The deploy workflow reads origination-workbench.workbook.json and injects it here — do not hand-maintain this value.
Azure region. Defaults to the target resource group location.
Value for the Environment resource tag. The workbook is hosted in one resource group but reads every environment the viewer can see.

properties.description: Cross-environment operations view for the Origination Workbench: deployments, Logic App runs, background jobs, open alerts, integration health, and links into App Insights and the in-app Usage Dashboard.
